import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    arr = list(map(int, input_data[1:1+n]))
    itv = int(input_data[1+n])
    arr.sort()

    def get(pos):
        ret = 0
        for i in range(pos, n):
            if arr[i] <= itv + arr[pos]:
                ret += 1
        return ret

    ans = 0
    for i in range(n):
        ans = max(ans, get(i))
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
